messages:
People Ops: Quick heads-up — welcome Elena Ruiz, who starts on Mon Apr 7 as Head of Private Deployments. She'll run the private deliv org and partner with Product for the first 6 weeks to land the VPC/on-prem roadmap. Intro + 6-week shadow rotation plan below. :tada:

Elena Ruiz: super excited to join everyone. immediate priorities: 1) KMS/HSM compliance handoff 2) stabilize private deployment onprem package 3) streamline onboarding for enterprise customers. happy to meet folks next week.

Samir Patel: congrats Elena! i'll be the interim day-to-day lead for Private for the transition window. plan: 6-week shadow rotation starting Apr 7 — pairing sessions, runbooks, oncall handover. i'll post a schedule in #eng-infra.

Mariam Okoye: congrats 🎉 — i'll sync on compliance artifacts and transfer access for audit logs. Q: who owns the customer success touchpoints during transition?

Diego Morales: welcome Elena! can we get an updated org chart and a 30/60/90 draft? also requesting a 45-min all-hands intro (opt-in) so Product/SE/Sales know the new contact.

People Ops: added an "Intro + Transition" doc in the People Ops Drive and created an "Elena: Intro + Shadow Rotation" calendar event. link: https://drive.redwood.internal/priv-deploy-transition (internal only). recruiting note below.

Tomas Berg: i'll own the recruiting loop to backfill the infra IC work Samir will step out of. hiring req going live tomorrow; target on-site interviews wk of Apr 20.

Samir Patel: for the shadow rotation checklist i'm including: access matrix, KMS handoff steps, onprem deploy runbook revision, customer handover notes, monitoring dashboards, and an oncall playbook. cc @Tomas Berg on the backfill priority.

Elena Ruiz: i'll host office hours Tue 10–11 PT for the first two weeks. PMs/SEs — please bring a 5-min summary of any active private deals or regulatory items.

People Ops: action items (short): 1) People Ops to publish org chart update by EOD Thu. 2) Samir to post weekly shadow schedule in #eng-infra. 3) Tomas/recruiting to open req + outreach. 4) Elena to run intro office hours and post 30/60/90. 5) Mariam to hand off compliance artifacts.

Diego Morales: noted, will share product context doc and customer list by tomorrow.

Mariam Okoye: will prepare a "Compliance Handoff Checklist" and add to the drive.

Samir Patel: posting the first-week pairing schedule in 10m. also leaving a short FAQ in the doc for common onprem gotchas.

Elena Ruiz: thanks all — looking forward. small ask: please ping me directly for high-priority private incidents during Apr so i can triage while ramping.

People Ops: thanks team — congrats again Elena! reactions: :tada: :wave: :raised_hands:

Diego Morales: :thumbsup:

Tomas Berg: will share the req and screening rubric today.

Samir Patel: ok, posting now.
